comparisons.name: cap-light
comparisons.description: The pull-down button at rest: the cap's fill and the standard bezel beside it, Aqua.

pixels.note: middle stop of the measured accent gradient, the cap's fill at mid height (spec: pop-up-button, Cap gradient, 51%, measured as #3987fd in Aqua and #1764da in Dark Aqua)
standard bezel fill (spec: push-button, Fill, measured)
no menu in the page until the button is pressed

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: While the mouse is held down on the button its menu is open and the cap deepens, Aqua.

pixels.note: 88% of the measured middle stop #3d88fd; the darkening is inferred (spec: pull-down-button, States, pressed / open: about 12%)
the title part of the bezel is unchanged (spec: pop-up-button, States, pressed: inferred)

comparisons.name: open-light
comparisons.description: After a click the menu is open below the button, left-aligned with it, and its first item is highlighted under the pointer, Aqua.

pixels.note: the cap stays deepened while the menu is open (inferred, as pressed)

first row, 2 pt inside the button's left edge and 4 pt below its box: the menu item highlight token over the menu material over the page, computed from the tokens (menu-item: highlight, measured, computed)

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the pull-down button, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the window background, measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB)
page just outside the ring (spec: focus-ring, Geometry)

comparisons.name: inactive-window-light
comparisons.description: In an inactive window the cap loses the accent and Tab draws no focus ring, Aqua.

pixels.note: the cap is drawn like the rest of the bezel (spec: pull-down-button, States, inactive window: inferred from the measured disabled rendering)
no focus ring in a window that is not key (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)
